title: 아파트 공지문 읽기: 단수·단전·점검 안내
summary: Read two short apartment notices (water shut-off and power outage due to inspection) and practice scanning for date/time, place, reason, and what residents should do. Focus on eight frequent labels/words.
objective: Learners will be able to read short building notices about water/power outages and inspections and quickly find date, time, affected area, and what residents should do; and recognize 8 frequent labels/words (일시, 장소, 사유, 점검, 작업, 단수, 단전, 문의).
exercises: Answer in the format used in the notice (e.g., 08:00): 공지 A의 단수는 몇 시에 끝납니까?
Copy exactly as written in the notice: 공지 B의 사유는 무엇입니까?
Copy exactly as written in the notice: 공지 A의 장소는 어디입니까?
Copy the sentence exactly as written in the notice: 공지 B에서 주민이 해야 하는 일은 무엇입니까?
Write the contact place and phone number exactly as written in the notices: 두 공지의 문의처는 어디입니까?
answers: 단전 전에 가전제품 플러그를 뽑아 주세요.

sections.heading: Sample notice A — 단수 안내 (water shut-off notice)
paragraphs: 사유: 건물 내부 배관 교체 작업
작업: 물 공급 중단 및 배관 교체
유의사항: 단수 전에 물을 미리 받아 두세요.

sections.heading: Sample notice B — 단전 안내 (power outage notice)
paragraphs: 작업: 변전실 점검 및 전력 차단
유의사항: 단전 전에 가전제품 플러그를 뽑아 주세요.

sections.heading: How to scan quickly
paragraphs: First look at the labels (일시, 장소, 사유, 작업, 유의사항, 문의), then read only the lines you need.
Get used to numbers and symbols such as 09:30, ~ (from–to), 층 (floor), 동 (building number). These notices use 24-hour time.
To find what residents should do, look in the 유의사항 (precautions) line for request endings like -세요.

sections.heading: Note
paragraphs: The notices here are learning examples, not real schedules or contact numbers.
